method: Zoos and aquariums within 100 km of the place centre (two bases for Tokyo & Kyoto), from Wikidata (zoo and aquarium classes) with visitors and animal counts from Wikidata, park infoboxes, Wikipedia text and web searches. A facility with a figure counts its yearly visitors; one without a figure but with at least 5 Wikipedia language editions counts a visitor estimate from that fame (capped at 1 million); the rest are listed as minor and not counted. Rating = 10 x square root of (total visitors / 6 million), at most 10; 2 if only minor facilities; 1 if none. OWN-AREA RULE (owner, 26 Oct 2026): a facility counts only when it belongs to the place, not a neighbouring city or region. Limits by kind of place: city 35 km, region and coastal area 60 km, national park and wilderness area 40 km, state/province, island and country 100 km, never across a border or the water. Facilities beyond the limit are kept in the list with the reason and do not count.
